api:
OV.BattleUI = {scene, open(B, opts), openInventory(unitId), refresh(), model: {kbStep(m:{w,h}, x, y, dir:'up'|'down'|'left'|'right', anchor|null) → {x, y, anchor}, logEntry(B, ev, ctx:{last:{}, seenAt:{}}) → {key, params, kind:'bad'|'warn'|'good', own, at, from}|null, blastConfirm(settings, difficulty) → bool, handName(type) → string}, debug: {tileToScreen, unitScreen, selectAndMove, state() (new fields: kcur, tapLock, pathSub, hint, report), hover(x,y) (now hides the kb cursor like a real mouse), perf, showAll, centre, log() → [{turn, side, kind, own, text, at, from}], kb(x,y,z), noteEvent(ev), report('turn'|'log')}}.
Settings read (all default safely when OV.Game.settings is undefined): kbCursor (default true), palette 'normal'|'cvd', reduceMotion 'auto'|'on'|'off', textScale 1|1.15|1.3 (map labels; HUD uses CSS var --ui-scale), NEW confirmBlast 'auto'|'always'|'never' ('auto' = on for Recruta/Veterano, i.e. B.mission.difficulty <= 1).
Battle keys: arrows move the tile cursor (hold to repeat, camera follows); Shift+arrows/WASD pan; Enter/Space confirm move/shot/throw at the cursor; Ctrl+Enter forced shot; ⌥+Enter opens the door without entering; T turns to face the cursor; Tab/1–0 jump to visible aliens while aiming or throwing; N opens the message log; ? opens the key sheet; ⌫ ends the turn (Enter does too when the cursor is not armed or sits on the selected soldier); Esc order is cancel → menu → report → hide cursor → Options. With kbCursor=false the old arrow behaviour returns (arrows pan, ⇧↑/⇧↓ change level).
OV.Presenter: new ctx.hooks.log(ev) (called for every event, visible or not, before animation); OV.Presenter.reduceMotion (no camera glides); text keys use '.f' variants for female soldiers; hidden-movement slices are 45 ms.
OV.FX.reduceMotion (bool; shake() becomes a no-op).
OV.BattleRender view additions: kcur {x,y,z}, palette, reduceMotion, textScale, path.sub, target.subCol may be a palette name ('out').
OV.InventoryUI.model.autoLoadout(soldier, stores (mutated), {night, researched, squad}) → loadout. equipScreen options gain optional `researched` (falls back to OV.Game.G.researched). The equip screen keyboard: arrows, Enter/Space pick and drop, ⌫ returns to stores, Tab/1–0 change soldier, C/V/A/X = Copiar/Colar/Auto-equipar/Esvaziar, Esc drops the picked item. The root .inv-equip is now a CSS container (`container: eq`) wrapping a new .eq-grid.
OV.Input: two-finger pinch is processed once per frame and zoom only starts after a 6 % distance change; Safari gesture events are ignored while touch pointers are down.
summary:
Persona round 1, battle/inventory fixer: I fixed 25 of the 31 findings in my files. The other 6 are fixed for the parts I own, and the exact patches for the rest are in open_issues. node tools/test.js --strict --i18n passes 635/635, with no missing keys apart from the suite's deliberate test key nao.existe.x. Results of the browser QA:
- **Pass:** qa/persona_r1_battle.mjs (new, about 75 checks, all at 1440×900, 1024×576 at 125 % zoom, and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834 with touch), ux_regress, battle_play and inventory_check.
- **full_battle:** played two battles to a win with no console errors. One check failed: «granadas lançadas: 0». The bot never called its grenade routine in either battle (no «granada:» lines in the log); I read this as a scenario where no alien was in range, because the G throw flow passes in battle_play and persona_r1.
- **full_campaign (run once):** the battle part played through with plain arrows and Enter and returned to the Geoscape. It then failed in the base screen (the «Todos» button in .bsc-proj timed out), which is in base_ui and not one of my files.
I looked at screenshots of every screen I changed: the HUD, keyboard cursor, aiming, explosive confirm, door, report, abort, colour-blind palette, iPad portrait and landscape, equip at 1440/1024/834 portrait, and the medikit panel. They are in scratchpad/ui4/persona_r1/.

What changed, by finding:
- **#13 keyboard can't pick a tile or target — fixed.** The Battlescape now has a real tile cursor. Arrow keys move it in straight screen lines (each press goes half a tile diagonally and alternates, so holding ↑ goes straight up and every tile can be reached). Holding an arrow repeats and the camera follows the cursor. The cursor is a white-on-black diamond with corner ticks. Enter or Space confirms a move, shot or throw with the same preview as the mouse. In aim or throw mode the cursor jumps to the nearest visible alien, but only for players who haven't used the mouse in the last 3 s; cancelling hides an automatically placed cursor again, so Enter goes back to ending the turn. Moving the mouse hides the cursor. There is a HUD hint and a «?» key sheet.
- **#15 path and reach states rely on colour — fixed.** Steps that keep the TU reserve are filled dots on a solid line; steps that eat it are hollow dots on a dashed line, with a bar where the reserve starts being used; unreachable steps are ✕. The reach outline is solid where the reserve is kept and dashed where it isn't. The 'cvd' palette uses blue, orange, magenta and white.
- **#16 enemy vs own unit shown mostly by colour — fixed in the Battlescape.** Aliens get a dashed diamond under their feet and a down-pointing chevron over their head, soldiers keep the ellipse. The minimap draws aliens as diamonds, and the alien buttons carry an alien glyph. The Geoscape UFO marker is not mine; patch in open_issues.
- **#7 explosive fires with allies in the blast on one click — fixed.** A second click, Enter or tap on the same target is required, with «Clique/Enter/Toque outra vez para disparar — atinge N aliados». This applies to shots and throws. It is on by default for Recruta and Veterano; the new setting confirmBlast controls it.
- **#8 explosive shot shows «Acerto ≈ 0 %» — fixed.** The label now reads «Explosão raio N · apanha o alvo · X UT» (just «Explosão raio N · X UT» on an empty tile), and the menu column «Prec.» is now «Pontaria N %» with a tooltip.
- **#2 Option over a door doesn't show the door cost — fixed.** With ⌥ held the label becomes «Abrir a porta sem entrar · N UT»; without it, a hint «⌥ + clique: abrir a porta sem entrar» appears under the path label.
- **#4 path label mixes cost and remaining energy — fixed.** It now reads «Custa 16 UT · ficam 40 · En 46».
- **#3 casualties during the alien turn go unexplained — fixed.** At the start of the player's turn a «Durante o turno alienígena» panel lists who died, was wounded, stunned or panicked, how (a shot or explosion from an alien, or «atacante não visto»), and has «Mostrar» / «Atacante» buttons that centre the camera. N, or a top-bar button, opens the full message log by turn.
- **#9 weapon names cut off, small HUD text — fixed.** Hand slots show two-line names, with short names only where needed, at 12.5 px. HUD labels are 11–12.5 px and scale with --ui-scale.
- **#10 and #6 auto-equip gives useless weapons — fixed.** The new pure autoLoadout only gives researched weapons that have ammo in stock and fit the soldier's Strength. Heavy weapons go to the strongest third of the squad. Rockets go in the backpack. Items not yet researched are marked «Por investigar» in the equip screen, and the in-battle fire menu disables them with «Equipamento ainda por investigar».
- **#0, #5 (button part), #17, #26 «Auto-equipar» button cut off — fixed.** The equip layout now follows the width of its container (CSS container queries), the buttons size to their text, and the selectors beat the conflicting rules in campaign.css.
- **#20 and #29 equip screen broken in iPad portrait — fixed.** The squad becomes a horizontal strip, the stores go under the soldier, and nothing has zero height or covers the right hand.
- **#14 equip screen not usable from the keyboard — fixed.** Arrows, Enter, ⌫, Tab, 1–0 and C/V/A/X all work, so both the base and briefing equip screens can be used without a pointer.
- **#1 medikit text spills out of the box — fixed.** The reason now sits under the action title and the cost column shows «—».
- **#11 aborting with nobody aboard loses the craft without warning — fixed.** The dialog now adds a red line «Ninguém está na nave: … perde-se (−200 pontos)» and the button reads «Abortar e perder a nave».
- **#12 briefing says dusk reduces visibility but nothing changes — fixed in the HUD.** The top bar shows «CRÉPUSCULO» or «PENUMBRA» with an honest tooltip that sight is not reduced. The briefing note is not mine; patch in open_issues.
- **#18 reduced motion ignored in the Battlescape — fixed.** The reduceMotion setting ('auto' follows the system) turns off HUD, inventory and equip animations, screen shake, camera glides and canvas pulses.
- **#19 text clipped at 125 % zoom — fixed for my parts.** Store names now wrap to two lines, so the two «Canhão Pesado: …» entries can be told apart, and the fire menu grows with its content. The base card and main-menu title are not mine; patch in open_issues.
- **#21 iPad portrait end-turn button covers the TU reserve — fixed.** At 960 px wide or less, the reserve moves to its own row inside the console and every HUD button can be tapped.
- **#22 two-finger pan changes zoom at the zoom limit — fixed, also on the Geoscape** because the change is in input.js. The pinch is handled once per frame with a 6 % dead zone.
- **#23 ghost path left after touch — fixed.** The touch preview is cleared after an action, on selecting another soldier and at turn start.
- **#24 visible alien hidden behind UFO walls — fixed.** Visible units hidden behind walls or tall objects are drawn semi-transparent on top, and aliens always show their chevron.
- **#25 touch targets under 32 px — fixed.** On touch screens the level buttons and the «Não voltar a perguntar» checkbox are at least 34 px tall.
- **#27 nothing says a tap speeds up the alien turn — fixed.** The banner now reads «Toque para acelerar» on touch, «Espaço ou clique para acelerar» otherwise. Hidden-movement turns also finish faster.
- **#28 pt-PT text not in the feminine for female soldiers — fixed in-battle.** I added '.f' variants (morta, ferida, paralisada, tratada, desaparecida, ajoelhada) in toasts, the log and the squad list. Debrief and memorial are not mine; patch in open_issues.
- **#30 icon-only HUD buttons have no labels on iPad — fixed in the Battlescape.** A long press (450 ms or more) on any HUD control shows its label and shortcut and cancels the click. dom.js is untouched.
deviations: Arrow keys now move the keyboard tile cursor when kbCursor is on (the default). Shift+arrows and WASD pan, and level changes moved to , . and PgUp/PgDn (⇧↑/⇧↓ only with kbCursor off). Holding an arrow moves the cursor with the camera following, so held arrows still scroll the map.
Enter confirms at the cursor only while the cursor is armed on a useful tile; otherwise, as before, it ends the turn. ⌫ always ends the turn. Space confirms at an armed cursor instead of «Feito».
In aim or throw mode, Tab cycles visible aliens rather than soldiers.
I added a new setting, confirmBlast ('auto'|'always'|'never'). It is read from OV.Game.settings and defaults to 'auto' when absent; the Options entry is a patch in open_issues.
The equip screen root (.inv-equip) now wraps an .eq-grid and is a CSS container (`container: eq`). Selectors written against `.inv-equip` as a grid should target `.eq-grid` instead.
Hand-slot names use the item name in two lines, with short forms (hud.short.<type>) for six long names. The full name stays in the aria-label and tooltip.
The debug-only fps readout (?debug=1) no longer intercepts clicks, and moves under the top bar below 1300 px wide.
On #30 I did not touch dom.js. Long-press labels are implemented in battle_ui for the battle HUD only.
open_issues: Shell fixer, screens.js and main.js — confirmBlast option. Add to the Opções «Acessibilidade» or «Jogo» section: optRow(T('scr.opt.confirmBlast'), sseg('confirmBlast', ['auto','always','never'].map((v) => ({ v, label: T('scr.opt.confirmBlast.' + v) }))), T('scr.opt.confirmBlast.hint')). Add the keys to pt-PT.screens.js: 'scr.opt.confirmBlast': 'Confirmar explosivos com aliados no raio', '.auto': 'Recruta e Veterano', '.always': 'Sempre', '.never': 'Nunca', '.hint': 'Pede um 2.º clique antes de disparar ou lançar um explosivo que atinge soldados teus'. Add confirmBlast: 'auto' to DEFAULT_SETTINGS in js/main.js. The battle already defaults safely without it.

Shell fixer, pt-PT.screens.js «Como Jogar» (scr.howto.key.* — the row count is hard-coded in screens.js table('scr.howto.key', 17, …)). Replace row 11 with ', . ou PgUp PgDn|Nível de vista abaixo / acima' and row 12 with 'Setas|Mover o cursor de casas (segurar repete; a câmara segue). Enter ou Espaço confirma andar, disparar ou lançar; ⇧ + setas ou W A S D deslocam a câmara'. Add rows: 'Tab / 1 … 0 a apontar|O cursor salta para o alienígena seguinte / n', 'Ctrl + Enter · ⌥ + Enter · T|Tiro forçado · abrir porta sem entrar · rodar para o cursor', 'N|Registo de mensagens', '?|Todas as teclas do combate'. Change row 16 to '⌫ (ou Enter sem cursor)|Terminar turno'. Bump the count to 21. Add touch rows to scr.howto.touch: 'Toque longo num botão|Mostra o nome e a tecla do botão' and 'Toque durante o turno alienígena|Acelera ×8'.

Shell fixer, pt-PT.screens.js: change 'scr.br.note.dusk' to 'Crepúsculo: mais escuro longe das luzes, mas os soldados continuam a ver até 20 casas.' Dusk (shade 1–9) has no mechanical effect on sight, and the HUD tooltip now says so.

Campaign UI owner, campaign_ui.js equip header (#5): when the craft is away, cp.eq.kicker should name the craft's location, e.g. «Equipar a bordo · {craft} ({place})», instead of «… · BASE {base}». Callers of OV.InventoryUI.equipScreen should also pass researched: G.researched explicitly (it currently falls back to OV.Game.G.researched).

Campaign UI owner, campaign.css lines 226–232 (.cp-eq .inv-equip … grid columns, .eq-btns max-width:214px): these caused the «AUTO-EQUIPAI» truncation. They are now overridden by higher-specificity container rules in battle.css and can be deleted.

Debrief and memorial gender (#28 remainder): add '.f' variants for scr.db.kia/scr.db.mia (pt-PT.screens.js), base.mem.cause.* (pt-PT.base.js) and cp.cause.* (pt-PT.campaign.js), and pick them with s.female in screens.js, base_ui.js and campaign_ui.js. Battle toasts, the log and the squad list already do this (bs.ev.kia.f, bs.status.mia.f, …).

Globe render owner (#16, Geoscape part): the red UFO dot and «Pequeno» label turn olive under deuteranopia. Give the UFO marker a light outline and a distinct shape (diamond), and use magenta in palette 'cvd'.
#19 remainder: the base facility card «L… Espa par…» (base_ui/basescape.css) needs line-clamp:2; the main-menu OVNI title (screens.css) needs clamp() on vh so it is not cut at 125 % zoom.

Owner of qa/full_campaign.mjs: bringIntoView uses plain arrows. These still scroll, because holding an arrow moves the keyboard cursor and the camera follows it, and the battle part of the run played through. For an exact camera pan, press Shift around the arrows (as I did in qa/full_battle.mjs). In this run full_campaign failed later, at «.bsc-proj .bsc-stepper .btn» «Todos» (30 s timeout, in base_ui, not mine).
Other UIs: the long-press label pattern (battle_ui.js longPress/showLongPress) could move into OV.Dom.tooltip for every touch UI. I didn't do it because dom.js isn't mine.

qa/full_battle.mjs reported «granadas lançadas: 0»: in this run the bot never called its grenade routine (it needs a visible alien within 14 tiles and 20 TU). The G throw flow is verified by battle_play and persona_r1_battle.
